Thanks Laura / Megan — quick tax note from revenue ops: 

- Company residency: since EchoHealth is EU-registered (Ireland VAT), the invoice should include the statement: "Reverse charge applies — customer is responsible for VAT under Article 196 of the VAT Directive."
- Please include both Redwood's UK VAT ID (GB123456789) and Redwood Inc. EU registration note. We will mark the invoice as zero-rated for VAT and include the customer VAT ID on the invoice.
- No VAT gross-up required if EchoHealth posts the reverse-charge; if EchoHealth requires Redwood to charge VAT, we need a local EU-entity billing route which will delay the invoice by ~3–5 business days.

Laura — please also add the following fields to the invoice PDF so EchoHealth AP can auto-match: invoice reference (RL-2027-06-EH-001), PO# 12345, and a single-line description for the true-up quantity and unit price.

On the wire details: for EUR wires please use our EUR account in DE with IBAN DE89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00 and reference the invoice ref. Marissa — can you confirm that account and whether we should include intermediary instructions?

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
